title: Webinar: Using Propane in Mid-Range Trucks
abstract: This webinar hosted by NACFE examines the operational, financial, and environmental performance of propane autogas in mid-range medium-duty truck fleets. Featuring fleet leaders from Bimbo Bakeries USA, Office Depot, and McAbee Trucking alongside PERC experts, the presentation covers total cost of ownership, lower maintenance demands compared to diesel emissions systems, fueling infrastructure setups, and renewable propane (rLPG) adoption. Findings show propane delivers stable fuel costs ($2.89/DGE vs $5.01/diesel), near-zero NOx emissions, simple three-way catalyst aftertreatment, and quick ROI without grant dependencies.
key_findings: Propane fuel cost averaged $1.91/gallon ($2.89/DGE), representing over a $2.00/DGE savings compared to diesel ($5.01/DGE).
Propane engines certified at 0.02 g/bhp-hr NOx easily surpass upcoming EPA27 requirements (0.035 g/bhp-hr) using simple three-way catalysts instead of complex SCR/DEF systems.
Bimbo Bakeries USA operates over 623 active LPG route trucks, utilizing self-contained mobile fueling stations and expanding renewable propane (rLPG) blends.
McAbee Trucking fully converted its box truck fleet to propane autogas, reporting engine replacement costs of $16,500 compared to $40,000 for diesel.
PERC announced an incentive program offering $7,500 per propane vehicle and $10,000 toward site preparation for fueling infrastructure starting September 2026.
